mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.name AS name, u.username AS username, u.major AS major, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '') AS deptName, COALESCE(rc.cycle_name,'') AS cycleName, latest.latestInterviewTime AS latestInterviewTime, latest.interviewLocation AS interviewLocation FROM ( SELECT r.user_id AS userId, s.interview_time AS latestInterviewTime, COALESCE(se.location, sl.location) AS interviewLocation, s.cycle_id AS cycleId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.user_id ORDER BY s.interview_time DESC ) AS rn FROM interview_schedule s INNER JOIN resume r ON r.resume_id = s.resume_id LEFT JOIN interview_session se ON se.session_id = s.session_id LEFT JOIN interview_slot sl ON sl.slot_id = s.slot_id ) latest INNER JOIN user u ON u.user_id = latest.userId AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN department d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN recruitment_cycle rc ON rc.cycle_id = latest.cycleId WHERE latest.rn = 1 ORDER BY latest.latestInterviewTime IS NULL ASC, latest.latestInterviewTime ASC
